title: Marking a task done checks the wrong row
scenario: You are on the TaskForge team, building a lightweight task board. Completed tasks sink to the bottom of each column, sorted by priority above that.
symptom: Marking a task done sometimes makes a completely different task's checkbox appear checked instead — or in addition. The task you actually clicked is not the one that visually changes.
hints: Mark one task done, then look very carefully at which OTHER task's checkbox changed. Is it really that task's own completion state?
TaskColumn.jsx maps over the sorted task list using the array index as each row's key. What happens to a key when the list it belongs to gets re-sorted?
Give each row a key that identifies the actual task, not its position in the list — something that doesn't change when the list is reordered.

rubric.description: TaskColumn renders each TaskRow with key={task.id} (a stable identity for that task), not the array index, since taskSort re-orders tasks whenever one is marked done.
Marking a task done moves it to the bottom of its column without any other, untouched task's checkbox changing to appear done.

The fix does not special-case any specific task title or id, and does not work by making taskSort stop reordering done tasks to the bottom (sorting must still visibly move a completed task after it is marked done).
Tasks are still sorted correctly — incomplete tasks ordered by priority above completed ones — after the fix.
